title: A year ago, AI couldn't read a clock. Now?
markup: One scene per spoken line, so a changed line is re-voiced alone. Numbers stay as words here; screen and captions show figures. Approved G0, Nov 19 2026.

scenes.title: Line 1
scenes.vo: Last year, the best AI read about one clock in eight.

scenes.title: Line 2
scenes.vo: And when it missed, it was off by about an hour.

scenes.title: Line 3
scenes.vo: Today, the best AI reads almost nine in ten.

scenes.title: Line 4
scenes.vo: Same kind of test, and the test clocks are kept secret, so it couldn't just memorise them.

scenes.title: Line 5
scenes.vo: People? Just over nine in ten. It's nearly caught up.

scenes.title: Line 6
scenes.vo: But two years ago, this clock fooled almost every AI.
